description: Transcritical R744 HP. Extends F1a with: (1) part-load COP degradation via PLF; (2) T_water_in dependence on optimum high-side pressure and gas-cooler effectiveness; (3) cycling losses below PLR_min.

unit.name: Generic 50 kW_th transcritical CO2 heat pump for high-temperature water heating
unit.source: Lorentzen (1994), Int. J. Refrigeration 17, 292-301; Sarkar et al. (2004), Int. J. Refrigeration 27, 830-838; Liao et al. (2000), Appl. Thermal Eng. 20, 831-841; Kim et al. (2004), Int. J. Refrigeration 27, 830-838.

C_d.note: Part-load degradation coefficient; CO2 compressor cycling is more efficient than reciprocating, so C_d=0.20 < ASHP 0.25 — Kim et al. (2004) CO2 inverter data

PLR_min.note: Minimum modulation before on/off cycling; CO2 inverter drives allow ~15% — Liao et al. (2000)

gamma_T_w_in.note: COP penalty per K increase of T_water_in above T_w_in_design: higher inlet T means smaller gas-cooler dT, worse heat extraction — Sarkar et al. (2004) Fig.4
